source: Derived from the upstream serializer. Primitive string fast path, cached algorithms, own validated options, binary-safe unordered serialization, framed buffers, sparse holes, ordered map pairs, DataView bytes, file timestamps and bigint typed arrays. Synchronous Node 24/Bun API; no browser crypto bundle.

implementation.basis: The object serializer is upstream-derived, with primitive fast paths and focused binary/collection corrections. The complete serializer is not an independent implementation.
implementation.targetScope: GAX client and stub cache-key hashing reached by Firestore callers.
implementation.remainingWork: Independently implement the cache-key/value serialization actually required by callers, preserving deterministic distinctions and the existing corrected binary/collection behavior.
